title: Matt LaFleur: I've got to do a better job of communicating with players

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Matt LaFleur: I've got to do a better job of communicating with players
sources.description: The NFL Players Association no longer publishes the full results of its player survey, but some of the results get reported — including that Packers head coach Matt LaFleur was downgraded by his players in 2025.
